Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Earlier bounded source reviews are partial acceptance. P5.03 and P8.04 remain nonclosed in the current graph; retained inverse and overlap experiments have not gained current-main qualification through consolidation.

Fresh context: Yes: independent integration audit.

Next action: Rebase the parity-ledger review onto current main/pins, reproduce admitted oracle/platform courts, reconcile resolved versus genuinely missing scenarios and return exact remaining findings. Do not inherit the old final-review checklist blindly.

Evidence: live graph; docs/verification/stp-finish-20260929; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Objective
Inspect the integrated implementation, pins and artifacts against the plan and the parity ledger.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (All). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
review; independent of implementers. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Every parity-ledger row verified against code and oracle receipts; exact pins recorded; unresolved findings returned to owners.

Verification
Reviewer reproduces bounded JVM/JS runs and oracle checks; summaries are not evidence.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
